text:
You need a full review and rebuild of parts of your recruitment system, with someone who can reconfigure the platform cleanly and improve the areas that are holding it back.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full stack developer with 7 years of experience working with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. While your post mentions PHP Laravel specifically, my background is on modern full stack web systems, and I’m confident I can help review the current setup, identify the weak points, and rebuild the parts that need attention in a structured way.

I approach this kind of work by first understanding the existing system end to end: the user flows, data model, admin workflows, and any integrations that are critical to recruitment operations. From there, I break the rebuild into manageable areas so the system can be improved without disrupting the whole platform unnecessarily. If there are pages, workflows, or backend pieces that are slow, hard to maintain, or not working as intended, I can help rework those into cleaner, more reliable components.

A relevant project was a home goods storefront rebuild for Juniper & Ash Home, where I replaced a slow theme-based shop with a headless storefront and CMS that the marketing team could edit themselves. The result was a reduction in largest contentful paint from 4.1s to 1.3s, and organic traffic increased by 38% in 3 months. That project required careful rebuilding, better structure, and attention to performance and maintainability — all important when reworking a system that people rely on every day.

If you’d like, I can start by reviewing the current recruitment system and outlining what should be rebuilt, what can be preserved, and the best way to phase the work so it’s practical and low-risk. I’m happy to discuss your current setup, the problem areas, and what a clean rebuild plan would look like.
